figurative_meaning_en: to open up, to leave open
example_sentences_in_bangla: দরজাটা হাট করে রেখো না, চোর ঢুকে যাবে।
জানালাটা হাট করে খুলে দাও, বাতাস আসুক।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't leave the door wide open, a thief might come in.
Open the window fully so that some air comes in.
note: This idiom derives from the idea of opening something as wide as a market (হাট), implying full openness.
